name: RPG Battler
description: Turn-based RPG battle system with player-controlled party combat
author: Nekon

max_battle_units.tooltip: Maximum units on the player side at battle START (battle_always members + picked members).

max_total_units.tooltip: Maximum player-side units over the whole battle, counting mid-battle summons. Summons beyond the cap fizzle.

round_start_delay.tooltip: How long the "Turn N starts" banner holds at the top of every round, in ms, before the first combatant acts. The round's turn order is already settled behind it, so this is the window for reading the lineup - and for watching an opening move land when an enemy wins initiative. Scaled by the player's battle-speed setting. 0 = no banner, rounds open immediately.

max_enemy_units.tooltip: Maximum enemy-side units at any moment. Enemy summon abilities are skipped by the AI (and fizzle) at the cap.

projectile_travel_size.tooltip: On-screen size in px of the traveling projectile sprite.

projectile_hit_size.tooltip: On-screen size in px of the hit/impact VFX.

difficulty.tooltip: Enemy health/power change per difficulty (%). Medium 0 = no status.

damage_floor.tooltip: Minimum % of a raw burst hit that always lands after flat armor (physical/magical) — caps how much armor can block. 25 = at least 25% of the hit gets through (armor caps at 75% reduction). 0 = armor may fully block (0 damage possible). Empty = at least 1 damage.

id.tooltip: Unique battle identifier used to start this battle from scripts.

name.tooltip: Display name for this battle encounter.

background.tooltip: Background asset for the battle scene (from assets.json). Leave empty to fall back to the current room's / dungeon's configured default asset.

loot.tooltip: Loot inventory granted when this battle is defeated (by fight victory or a scripted defeat). Empty = the inventory with the same id as the battle, if one exists.

threat.tooltip: Battle threat on the 1-100 design scale (vermin ~5-9, pack ~15-26, elite ~30-45, boss ~50-65, chapter boss ~80-100; overflow allowed). Added ON TOP of any enemy template `threat` traits summed across all waves — games without per-character threat put the full value here. Drives loot budgets, XP, and threat-priced economies.

enemies.tooltip: Enemy composition for this battle — the first wave.

is_live_instance.tooltip: Bring an existing live character into the fight as-is instead of spawning a fresh copy from a template. The character keeps its own stats, abilities and equipment, and survives the battle teardown.

character_id.tooltip: Character template to spawn this enemy from.

live_character_ids.tooltip: IDs of the live characters to bring in - one enemy each, in this order. Typed by hand because live characters are created at runtime by game scripts (game.createCharacter), so no dropdown can list them. An ID with no live character behind it is skipped with an error in the console.

amount.tooltip: Number of copies of this template to spawn. A live entry spawns nothing, so its count is however many IDs it lists.

enemies2.tooltip: Second wave — spawns instead of victory once the first wave is wiped out. The party keeps its health, statuses and cooldowns, so a wave is a stamina test rather than a fresh fight. Leave empty for a single-wave battle.

is_live_instance.tooltip: Bring an existing live character into the fight as-is instead of spawning a fresh copy from a template. The character keeps its own stats, abilities and equipment, and survives the battle teardown.

character_id.tooltip: Character template to spawn this enemy from.

live_character_ids.tooltip: IDs of the live characters to bring in - one enemy each, in this order. Typed by hand because live characters are created at runtime by game scripts (game.createCharacter), so no dropdown can list them. An ID with no live character behind it is skipped with an error in the console.

amount.tooltip: Number of copies of this template to spawn. A live entry spawns nothing, so its count is however many IDs it lists.

description.tooltip: Description shown on hover / in the encyclopedia.

id.tooltip: Unique projectile/VFX identifier referenced by an ability's meta.projectile.

travel_type.tooltip: Travel sprite format. single = one image (PNG/GIF). sheet = horizontal spritesheet animated by travel_frames/travel_fps.

travel_image.tooltip: Travel sprite that flies from caster to target (single image or spritesheet strip). Leave empty for an on-hit-only effect (the hit VFX manifests at the target, no travel).

travel_frames.tooltip: Number of frames in the travel spritesheet.

travel_fps.tooltip: Travel spritesheet playback frames per second.

travel_cols.tooltip: Frames per row in the travel sheet (for grid sheets). Leave empty for a single horizontal row. A partial last row is trimmed.

starting_rotation.tooltip: Degrees to correct the travel sprite's drawn orientation. Baseline 0 = the sprite points at the top.

speed.tooltip: Travel speed in px/sec. Flight duration = distance / speed.

arc.tooltip: Lob the travel sprite along an arc instead of a straight line.

hit_type.tooltip: Hit/impact VFX format. single = one image. sheet = horizontal spritesheet animated by hit_frames/hit_fps.

hit_image.tooltip: Impact VFX shown at the target on land (single image or spritesheet). Optional.

hit_frames.tooltip: Number of frames in the hit spritesheet.

hit_fps.tooltip: Hit spritesheet playback frames per second.

hit_cols.tooltip: Frames per row in the hit sheet (for grid sheets). Leave empty for a single horizontal row. A partial last row is trimmed.

css_class.tooltip: Extra CSS class on the spawned sprites (glow, scale, tint).

sound.tooltip: Sound id(s) played on launch (travel) / appear (on-target). Passed straight to game.playSounds.

hit_sound.tooltip: Sound id(s) played on impact / land.

game_settings.label: Battle Animation Speed
game_settings.tooltip: Controls the speed of battle animations and action delays.

game_settings.label: Battle Difficulty
game_settings.tooltip: How tough the enemies are during the battle. Medium is default.

character_traits.tooltip: Horizontal fine-adjust (%) for the battle overlay (health bar, tokens), measured from the slot center. Art Manager tuning already centers the body, so this usually stays 0. Positive = right.
Vertical fine-adjust (%) for the battle overlay (health bar, tokens), measured from the slot top. Tune per character height (short/tall). Positive = down.
Reward weight of this NPC. A battle's threat is the sum over its enemy party; reward systems scale defeat payouts off it.
If true, this party member never joins battles (skipped when the player side is assembled).
If true, this party member is always in the battle party and cannot be deselected in the pre-battle picker.

Support combatant: joins every battle outside the party limit (never shown in the pre-battle picker), acts in the turn order from the sidelines with a floating portrait instead of a battlefield slot, and can never be targeted or damaged. Invisible to ally-counting effects.
If true, this player-side character acts on its own in battle – the battle AI picks its abilities and targets instead of the manual ability panel.

item_traits.description: When the ability granted by this item is cast in battle, one dose (quantity) is consumed.

ability_definitions.description: What this ability can target.
Usability gate: the caster must have at least 1 stack of ANY of these statuses or the ability is unusable (greyed out).
When true, removes 1 stack of the first require_status_self status the caster holds on cast. Renders inline on the Requires line as "(consumed)".
If true, using this ability does not end the turn. Limited to 1 bonus action per turn.
Caster must have LESS than X% HP (0-100) for ability to be usable.
Caster must have MORE than X% HP (0-100) for ability to be usable.
Target must have LESS than X% HP (0-100).
Target must have MORE than X% HP (0-100).
AI priority weight. Higher values = AI prefers this ability.
Max charges available. 0 = unlimited (cooldown only). Charges reset between battles.
The ability begins the battle on cooldown for its full `cd`, so it cannot be cast on the first turn. Needs a `cd` to do anything.
Shared cooldown group. When this ability is cast, all abilities with the same cd_group on this character also go on cooldown.
When true, this ability uses raw `power` only; `power_amplifier` is ignored.

When true, this ability's damage / heal / status-stack values are taken as-is and do NOT scale with the caster's `power` (overrides `power_amplifier` too – implies `unamplified`). Target armor / resists and heal amplifier stats still apply. Use for items, scrolls, environmental triggers, or anything where the caster is the user rather than the source.

Channelled ability. On cast, a channel token showing this ability's icon is placed on the caster; the ability re-fires on each of the caster's turns at its cast-time power and effects until the caster is stunned. Casting a channel replaces any channel the caster already has.
Flavour/synergy tag for this ability (fire, water, light, ...). Does not affect mitigation – mitigation follows damage_type. Reserved for future school-synergy systems.

Projectile/VFX definition (from the Projectiles tab). Leave empty for a melee cast (caster lunges). If set: a travel sprite (travel_image) flies caster→target then plays the hit VFX; a def with only a hit_image manifests the VFX at the target (no travel).

ability_definitions.ingame_description: [v]% chance for the effect to take effect.
ability_definitions.description: Percent chance (0-100) for the entire effect to occur. Undefined = always happens.

The cast costs no action of any kind — the caster acts again instead of ending their turn. On a normal ability it refunds the main action and leaves the one-per-turn bonus action untouched; on an ability that is already meta.bonus_action it also refunds the bonus slot, so that bonus stays available. Granted per-effect, so pairing it with `chance` on the same effect gives a chance to act again — the grant is rolled with that chance, and a failed roll ends the turn normally. Needs no target: an effect carrying only this still works. Applies to enemies as well as the player. Give the ability a cooldown or a cost, or a free action with neither can be recast indefinitely. Rolled once per cast — bounces never re-roll it.
Damage as % of caster's power (base-100: 120 = 120%)

Hit damage type. 'physical' is reduced by physical_armor, 'magic' by magical_armor (both flat, min 1 dmg), 'absolute' ignores armor. Elemental flavour is carried by the ability's school, not the damage type.
Healing as % of caster's power (base-100: 100 = 100%), applied to the effect's target(s).
Heal the caster for this % of caster power. Independent of the ability's target (useful on offensive abilities).

Added to the caster's lifesteal stat for THIS cast only, on top of whatever gear and strains already give them. Heals for this % of the ability's TOTAL damage dealt (after defenses), splash included, counting only damage that reached health. SUMS across the ability's effects.

Added to the caster's crit_chance for THIS cast only, on top of their stat. SUMS across the ability's effects and applies to every damage roll in the cast, splash and bounces included. Unlike a self-applied status — which lands after the damage loop and so only helps the next cast — this affects the cast carrying it.
Added to the caster's crit_multi for THIS cast only. SUMS across the ability's effects. Only matters when the cast actually crits.

Added to the caster's accuracy for THIS cast only, cutting through the target's dodge. A negative value adds to the target's dodge instead, making this cast likelier to miss. SUMS across the ability's effects.
Status IDs to apply to the ability's target(s). Stacks set by status_stacks_target (default 1).
Stacks to apply per status in status_apply_target. Default 1. For power-scaled statuses: actual = power × value / 100.
Duration in turns for target-applied statuses. Overrides the status template duration. Omit to use template default.
Status IDs to apply to caster.
Stacks to apply per status in status_apply_self. Default 1.
Duration in turns for self-applied statuses. Overrides the status template duration. Omit to use template default.
Status IDs to remove from the ability's target(s). Omit status_remove_stacks_target to clear all stacks of each.
Stacks to remove per status in status_remove_target. Unset = remove all stacks. Must be >= 1 when set.
Modify ability cooldowns (signed). Positive = increase, negative = refresh.
Modify ability charges (signed). Positive = add, negative = reduce.
The effect only applies to targets that have at least 1 stack of this status; others are skipped.

When true, removes 1 stack of require_status_target from each target the effect applies to. Consumed AFTER the damage is applied, so an ability that spends a damage-amplifying mark still benefits from it on that hit; a dodge or a vetoed apply leaves the status standing.
Remove cleansable tokens. Ally: remove negative. Enemy: remove positive.
Status IDs to remove from the caster.
Stacks to remove per status in status_remove_self. Unset = remove all stacks.
Status IDs to apply to all of the caster's living allies (includes the caster).
Stacks to apply per status in status_apply_allies. Default 1.
Duration in turns for ally-applied statuses. Omit to use template default.
Status IDs to remove from all of the caster's living allies (includes the caster). Omit status_remove_stacks_allies to clear all stacks.
Stacks to remove per status in status_remove_allies. Unset = remove all stacks.
Status IDs to apply to all of the caster's living enemies.
Stacks to apply per status in status_apply_enemies. Default 1.
Duration in turns for enemy-applied statuses. Omit to use template default.
Status IDs to remove from all of the caster's living enemies. Omit status_remove_stacks_enemies to clear all stacks.
Stacks to remove per status in status_remove_enemies. Unset = remove all stacks.

Damage-only spill to N neighbors of the primary target. SUMS across the ability's effects (a gem + a tier add up instead of overlapping). Neighbors are the target's positional party-mates. Needs splash_damage to deal anything.

Percent of each damage entry the splashed neighbors take. SUMS across effects, and applies to EVERY damage entry in the ability, each in its own damage_type. Damage only – use splash_statuses to spill statuses too.

Percent of the target statuses the splashed neighbors receive, relative to what the primary target gets – 50 gives neighbors half the stacks. SUMS across effects, and applies to EVERY status_apply_target in the ability, keeping each one's duration. Unset or 0 applies no statuses to neighbors. Needs splash_count.

After the ability resolves, the whole ability re-resolves this many more times on random targets of the same side (random enemies if it targets enemies, random allies if it targets allies), with a short delay between bounces. By default a hop cannot land on the previous target (see bounce_same); the chain ends early if no valid target remains. Bounces re-apply the effects only – they do NOT re-pay cost or trigger cooldown/charges again.

ability_definitions.ingame_description: Can bounce to the same target
ability_definitions.description: When true, a bounce may land on the same target as the previous hop. When false (default), consecutive hops must hit different targets and the chain ends early if none remain.

TOTAL number of times the ability strikes the SAME target – the primary cast counts, so 3 = the normal hit plus 2 extra strikes, and 1 or less adds nothing. Extra strikes re-resolve the whole ability with a short delay each and fizzle if the target dies – remaining strikes are lost. They re-apply the effects only – they do NOT re-pay cost or trigger cooldown/charges again. Melee flurries re-lunge per strike; for hops between random targets use bounce instead.

Spawn a combatant from this character template onto the caster's side. It joins the battle and acts this round based on its speed (not added to the persistent party). Use summon_amount for several copies of the SAME template; for different templates give each its own effect with its own id. Ignored on bounces.
How many copies of this effect's summon to spawn (default 1). Only for repeats of the same template — different templates belong in separate effects.

Statuses applied to the combatant(s) summoned THIS cast (by any effect's summon). Every effect carrying it contributes independently, so multiple effects stack rather than dedupe. Stacks set by summon_status_stacks; a status with meta.power_scaling scales its stacks off the caster's power.
Stacks per status in summon_status (default 1). Power-scaled if the status has meta.power_scaling.

locale.val: Stop channelling – ends its ongoing effects, such as recurring damage and upkept statuses.

status_meta.description: If true, the status is cleared at end of battle (rpg_battler cleanup hook).
If true, stacks scale with caster's power/sorcery on apply (rpg_battler combat math).
If true, this status is a channel: it is removed from whoever holds it the moment its CASTER (the live instance's source) is stunned. Works for self-buffs and enemy debuffs alike.

If set, the status ticks damage of this type on the affected character's turn, mitigated by the matching % resist (resist_burn / resist_poison / resist_bleed); 'absolute' ignores resists. Resist above 100% turns the tick into healing. Combined with power_scaling for caster-scaled DoT magnitude.
Character stat (non-resource) whose value seeds this status's initial stacks at battle start. Empty = starts at 0.
If true, the holder forfeits every battle action while the status is held (an obstacle/dummy). Unlike stun, nothing is consumed and no recover float is shown.

character_stats.name: Health
character_stats.description: Hit-point resource. The character is defeated when it reaches 0. The only resource stat the battler manages.
character_stats.ingame_description: Hit points. When health reaches 0, the character is defeated.

character_stats.name: Power
character_stats.description: Base scaling stat. Ability damage = effective power x (damage aspect / 100); healing scales the same way. Effective power = (power + power_bonus) x (1 + power_amplifier/100), except `unamplified` abilities which use raw power only.
character_stats.ingame_description: Base damage multiplier for abilities and healing.

character_stats.name: Power Bonus
character_stats.description: Flat gear-style addition to power, applied before power_amplifier – so it gets amplified too. Ignored by `unamplified` abilities (basic attack uses raw power).
character_stats.ingame_description: Flat power added before amplification. Ignored by `unamplified` abilities, so a basic attack does not benefit from it.

character_stats.name: Power Amplifier
character_stats.description: Percent multiplier on (power + power_bonus): effective power = (power + power_bonus) x (1 + value/100). 100 doubles power. Ignored by `unamplified` abilities.
character_stats.ingame_description: Percentage boost applied to power for ability scaling. 100 = +100% = doubles power.

character_stats.name: Speed
character_stats.description: Turn-order sort key – combatants act from highest to lowest speed each round. No other effect.
character_stats.ingame_description: Determines turn order in battle. Higher speed acts first.

character_stats.name: Physical Armor
character_stats.description: Flat amount subtracted from each physical burst hit after all multipliers. Result is floored at 1 damage; negative armor adds damage instead. DoT ticks ignore armor (they use resists).
character_stats.ingame_description: Flat reduction to physical hit damage. Always leaves at least 1 damage; negative values increase damage taken.

character_stats.name: Magical Armor
character_stats.description: Flat amount subtracted from each magic burst hit after all multipliers. Result is floored at 1 damage; negative armor adds damage instead. DoT ticks ignore armor (they use resists).
character_stats.ingame_description: Flat reduction to magic hit damage. Always leaves at least 1 damage; negative values increase damage taken.

character_stats.name: Crit Chance
character_stats.description: Percent chance (0-100) rolled on each damaging hit. Only rolled when above 0.
character_stats.ingame_description: Chance to critically hit (0-100%).

character_stats.name: Crit Multi
character_stats.description: Bonus percent damage on a critical hit: damage x (1 + value/100). 50 = 1.5x total, 150 = 2.5x – this is the bonus on top, not the total multiplier.
character_stats.ingame_description: Extra damage on critical hit (%). 50 = 1.5x damage.

character_stats.name: Dodge
character_stats.description: Percent chance (0-100) to negate an incoming hit entirely.
character_stats.ingame_description: Chance to avoid incoming damage entirely (0-100%).

character_stats.name: Accuracy
character_stats.description: Reduces the target's effective dodge by this many points (flat), applied before the dodge cap. Negative accuracy adds to the target's dodge instead, so an attacker below 0 can miss a target that has no dodge of its own. 0 = no effect.
character_stats.ingame_description: Cuts through the target's dodge (flat %). Negative accuracy adds to their dodge instead – even a target with no dodge can be missed.

character_stats.name: Lifesteal
character_stats.description: Percent of the health an ability strips from its targets that is healed back to the caster. Applies to EVERY ability the character casts; an effect's `lifesteal` aspect adds on top for that one cast. Counts only damage that reached health — a shield-absorbed hit steals nothing — and the heal is shaped by heal_amplification and heal_received_mult like any other.
character_stats.ingame_description: Heals the attacker for this % of the damage they deal.

character_stats.name: Burn Resist
character_stats.description: Percent reduction applied to each burn DoT tick. Unclamped – above 100 the tick heals instead of damaging.
character_stats.ingame_description: Reduces burn DoT damage (%). Above 100% the burn heals instead.

character_stats.name: Poison Resist
character_stats.description: Percent reduction applied to each poison DoT tick. Unclamped – above 100 the tick heals instead of damaging.
character_stats.ingame_description: Reduces poison DoT damage (%). Above 100% the poison heals instead.

character_stats.name: Bleed Resist
character_stats.description: Percent reduction applied to each bleed DoT tick. Unclamped – above 100 the tick heals instead of damaging.
character_stats.ingame_description: Reduces bleed DoT damage (%). Above 100% the bleed heals instead.

character_stats.name: Dmg Dealt %
character_stats.description: Additive percent modifier on outgoing damage. Summed with the per-missing-HP and per-ally bonuses, then damage x max(1 + total/100, 0.1).
character_stats.ingame_description: Additive % modifier to all outgoing damage.

character_stats.name: Dmg Taken %
character_stats.description: Additive percent modifier on incoming damage: damage x max(1 + value/100, 0.1), applied before armor. Positive = takes more damage.
character_stats.ingame_description: Additive % modifier to all incoming damage. Positive = take more.

character_stats.name: Heal Amp
character_stats.description: Percent boost to healing this character casts – heals, self-heals, and lifesteal: healing x (1 + value/100).
character_stats.ingame_description: Multiplier for healing effects cast by this character.

character_stats.name: Heal Received %
character_stats.description: Additive percent modifier on healing this character receives: healing x (1 + value/100). Positive = receives more.
character_stats.ingame_description: Additive % modifier to all incoming healing. Positive = receive more.

character_stats.name: Shield
character_stats.description: Battle-start seed for the shield status: a status whose meta.source is set to this stat id is applied with this many stacks when battle begins. Each shield stack absorbs 1 damage before health. Seeded stacks inherit the status's own duration, so a seeded shield runs the same clock as a cast one.
character_stats.ingame_description: Starting shield stacks at battle start. Each stack absorbs 1 damage.

character_stats.name: Preparation
character_stats.description: Battle-start seed for the preparation status: a status whose meta.source is set to this stat id is applied with this many stacks when battle begins. Preparation gates certain powerful abilities.
character_stats.ingame_description: Starting preparation stacks at battle start.

character_stats.name: Thorns
character_stats.description: Battle-start seed for the thorns status: a status whose meta.source is set to this stat id is applied with this many stacks when battle begins. Each stack reflects 1 flat damage to the attacker per hit taken; stacks are not consumed, and shields do not stop the reflection. Ability-applied thorns is power-scaled; this battle-start seed is a raw stack count.
character_stats.ingame_description: Starting thorns stacks at battle start. Each stack reflects 1 damage back to the attacker per hit.

character_stats.name: Dmg/Missing HP
character_stats.description: Adds value x missing-health fraction x 100 percentage points to outgoing damage. Example: 0.5 at half health = +25% damage.
character_stats.ingame_description: % damage bonus scaled by fraction of missing HP.

character_stats.name: Dmg/Ally
character_stats.description: Adds this many percentage points to outgoing damage per living ally, excluding self.
character_stats.ingame_description: % damage bonus per alive ally.

character_stats.name: Focus Fire
character_stats.description: Intended: attacks mark the target, and each mark raises this attacker's damage against it by this stat's value in percent. Not wired up in the plugin scripts yet – defined for future use.
character_stats.ingame_description: Marks target on attack. Each mark increases damage from this attacker by this stat's value %.

character_stats.name: Stagger Threshold
character_stats.description: Base stagger stacks needed to stun this character: effective threshold = ceil(base x (1 + stagger_threshold_pct/100)). 0 or below = cannot be staggered. On trigger the target is stunned and all stagger is consumed.
character_stats.ingame_description: Stagger tokens needed to trigger a stun. Higher = harder to stun.

character_stats.name: Stagger Threshold %
character_stats.description: Percent multiplier on stagger_threshold: effective threshold = ceil(base x (1 + value/100)). Braced grants +100 while recovering from a stun.
character_stats.ingame_description: Additive % bonus to stagger threshold. Granted by Braced and similar effects.

character_stats.name: Bonus Stun Damage
character_stats.description: Percent extra damage against staggered targets: damage x (1 + value/100). Active while the target is stunned and through the braced recovery window.
character_stats.ingame_description: Extra damage % dealt to staggered targets – while stunned and through the braced recovery.

character_stats.name: Reflect
character_stats.description: Battle-start seed for the reflect status: a status whose meta.source is set to this stat id is applied with this many stacks when battle begins. Each stack returns 1% of the damage that reaches health back to the attacker.
character_stats.ingame_description: Starting reflect stacks at battle start. Each stack returns 1% of damage taken to the attacker.

character_statuses.name: Braced
character_statuses.description: Recovering from a stun: stagger threshold doubled, but exposed to bonus stun damage.

character_statuses.name: Burn
character_statuses.description: Searing damage each turn. Burns hot but burns out fast in 3 turns.

character_statuses.name: Poison
character_statuses.description: A slow trickle of poison damage each turn. Does not expire on its own – only an Antidote or a cleansing spell removes it.

character_statuses.name: Bleed
character_statuses.description: Bleeds each turn. Lasts 5 turns by default.

character_statuses.name: Shield
character_statuses.description: A crust of force over the body. Each stack soaks 1 damage before health, and the whole shield fades after 3 turns.

character_statuses.name: Stagger
character_statuses.description: Accumulating pressure toward a stun. When stacks reach the target's stagger threshold, the target is stunned and all stagger is consumed.

character_statuses.name: Thorns
character_statuses.description: Reflects 1 damage per stack back to the attacker on every incoming hit, even one a shield absorbs.

character_statuses.name: Death Defiance
character_statuses.description: Survives a lethal blow with 1 HP. Consumed on trigger.

character_statuses.name: Combo
character_statuses.description: Required for combo attacks. Consumed on use.

character_statuses.name: Reflect
character_statuses.description: Returns 1% of the damage that reaches health per stack back to the attacker. Damage a shield soaks stays where it landed.

records.title: Burn
records.summary: Hot fire damage each turn for 3 turns. Cleansed by Salve.

records.title: Poison
records.summary: Trickle of damage each turn. Does not expire until cleansed with an Antidote (or battle ends). Reapplications stack into the same dose.

records.title: Bleed
records.summary: Bleeds each turn for 5 turns. Cleansed by Bandage.

records.title: Shield
records.summary: Soaks 1 damage per stack before health. Fades after 3 turns.

records.title: Stun
records.summary: The character cannot act on their next turn.

records.title: Stagger
records.summary: Accumulating pressure toward a stun. When the count reaches the target's stagger threshold, the target is stunned and all stagger is consumed.

records.title: Thorns
records.summary: Reflects flat damage back to the attacker on every incoming hit.

records.title: Death Defiance
records.summary: Survives a lethal blow with 1 HP. Consumed on trigger.

records.title: Preparation
records.summary: Required to use certain powerful abilities. Consumed on use.

records.title: Combo
records.summary: Required for combo attacks. Consumed on use.

records.title: Braced
records.summary: Recovering from a stun. Stagger threshold doubled for the duration.

records.title: Reflect
records.summary: Returns a share of the damage you take back to the attacker.
